messages:
noah: Quick experiment idea 1: run a 3-day "bootcamp" for a small DP cohort to speed onboarding. Bootcamp = 1:1 30m concierge + guided checklist + sample infra snippets. Control = self-serve docs only. Goal: see if concierge materially raises activation & actionable feedback. Thoughts?
courtney: 👍 Love it. Suggest N=30, randomized 15/15. Stratify by use-case (chat vs embeddings vs private). We'll measure time-to-first-success and checklist completion.
li: Metrics to capture: a) time_to_first_api_call (mins), b) checklist_completion_rate (pct), c) CS_touch_minutes, d) upgrade_intent_flag (Y/N). Also capture freeform blockers. Keep the active window 7 days after bootcamp.
frank: Ops questions: CS staffing for 1:1 slots, consent language for data capture, and voucher/credit automation. We can use voucher flow for $100 credit. Legal needs the consent blurb included.
oproduct-bot: bot: Created cohort tag `dp-bootcamp-jun2026` and outreach sequence `dp-bootcamp-nudges`. Use `/outreach start dp-bootcamp-nudges --cohort=dp-bootcamp-jun2026`
courtney: For randomization, we'll use invite link A/B: linkA=bootcamp, linkB=docs. Need to ensure even split and record group in participant CSV. Also add a small pre-survey asking expected setup time.
noah: Acceptance criteria for success (simple): 1) statistically higher activation rate (p<0.1 given small N) OR 2) qualitative: >60% of bootcamp participants report a blocker that we can fix within 2 weeks. If either, we iterate and scale.
li: Dashboard: create comparison charts vs control cohort for onboarding_time_median, checklist_pct, tokens_7d. Add tag filter. I can take dashboard item.
frank: I'll own logistics: schedule CS slots, generate voucher codes (`/voucher create --amount=100 --count=30 --tag=dp-bootcamp-jun2026`), and draft consent. Will loop in legal.
courtney: Outreach cadence: Day 0 invite, Day 1 bootcamp session, Day 3 checklist reminder, Day 6 survey nudge. Use outreach-runner sequence. Include calendar booking link in invite.
noah: Timeline ask: invite send Mon 2026-06-08, randomization window closes Jun 15, bootcamps Jun 16-18, active window ends Jun 25, report Jul 2. Need signoffs by Fri EOD (prod, CS, legal).
li: Also add triage pipeline: webhooks -> triage board labels (blocker, doc-fix, infra). Triage SLA: ack 24h, assign 48h.
courtney: I'll prepare participant CSV and draft invite copy by Thu. We'll reconvene Fri to finalize.
frank: noted. I'll run voucher command once legal okays consent. :thumbsup:
noah: If no objections I'll lock this tomorrow. Excited to try a lightweight ops-led experiment.
